result.title: Rename my account without moving my workspace
result.acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Open Profile from the header. Offer availability feedback and enforce the same server-side uniqueness policy at save and signup. Keep IDs, role, Home and preferences, and refresh header and profile metadata.

**Verify** · Race two users for the same name. Exactly one wins. Verify the new login and recovery name, the old login fails before reuse, and there is no cross-account access after name reuse.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-060, WI-065, WI-068

**Queue** · Follows WI-069 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
